content: Deterministic-inference literature Thinking Machines Lab blog, arxiv 2511.17826 TBIK, arxiv 2606.21023 HEAL achieves cross-hardware bit-exact ML inference only via batch-invariant/order-invariant custom kernels forcing a fixed reduction order; requires owning the inference framework's kernel code, heavier than this milestone needs, and still narrows to same-vendor-family execution paths in most cases. Confirms: do not reach for a full deterministic-inference framework this milestone; a post-hoc quantization/rounding pass on the output tensor is the lightweight alternative, appropriate for this project's looser goal tolerant hash for job verification, not bitwise ML reproducibility.
